messages.subject: rCharts not working on ShinyApps
parts:

This is because the shiny server does not have rCharts package installed... Anyone can suggest a way to overcome this?

Ryo,
The app that you included is not deployed on shinyapps.io.  If you are having an issue with the application, the first thing to do is to see whether you see any errors in the logs by running:
rsconnect::showLogs() or looking within the shinyapps.io dashboard under application -> Logs.

Best,
Tareef
